taskContext: Root cause of Chrome mobile black screen confirmed: crossorigin on same-origin <script type=module> triggers CORS preflight via Cloudflare. Chrome mobile enforces strict CORS → blocks execution → black screen. Fix: removed crossorigin, clean HTML.
reasoningSteps: deployed 28+ iterations debugging Chrome mobile black screen
v269 diagnostic build confirmed React modules never execute
v277 dynamic import exposed MIME type error from missing Vite build
final diagnosis: crossorigin attribute causes Cloudflare CORS preflight
Chrome mobile enforces CORS for module scripts — blocks on preflight failure
solution: remove crossorigin — it is only needed for CDN-hosted modules
